verses.text: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
lines: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
You have set your glory above the heavens!

verses.text: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.
lines: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength,
because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

verses.text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
lines: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers,
the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;

verses.text: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
lines: what is man, that you think of him?
What is the son of man, that you care for him?

verses.text: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
lines: For you have made him a little lower than the angels,
and crowned him with glory and honor.

verses.text: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:
lines: You make him ruler over the works of your hands.
You have put all things under his feet:

verses.text: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
lines: yes, and the animals of the field,

verses.text: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.
lines: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea,
and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

verses.text: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
lines: how majestic is your name in all the earth!
